business: OliveIQ: a Greek-language olive-grove logbook web app with δάκος alerts and an OPEKEPE-ready PDF
by_segment: Family olive grower (part-time, about 100-400 trees, also has another job or a pension)
Agronomist or ΚΥΔ consultant who keeps diaries and files ΟΣΔΕ for 50-300 growers
Full-time olive producer (about 1,000-3,000 trees, oil is the main income)
by_behaviour: Leans on the agronomist or cooperative
why_not: I've kept my grove in my notebook and my head for thirty years and it works. I'm not going to sit and type every spraying and every bag of fertiliser into a phone after a day in the field.

The ΚΥΔ already does my ΟΣΔΕ and keeps the diary through their software, and I hear about δάκος from the γεωπόνος and the men at the καφενείο. With my pension I'm not paying €49 for a second app that does what someone already does for me.

I keep diaries and file ΟΣΔΕ for over a hundred growers; I can't move their records onto an app from one independent developer I've never heard of. If it disappears next year, or the PDF isn't accepted, it's my name on the file, not his.

I keep diaries for a couple of hundred growers; I can't move their records into an app made by one developer I've never heard of and then find out next year it's gone or the PDF isn't accepted. The free tier with one grove tells me nothing about how it handles my real workload.

I already keep diaries and file ΟΣΔΕ for 200 growers with the ΚΥΔ software and my own spreadsheets, and the δάκος warnings come from the ΔΑΟΚ traps and from me. This looks built for one grower with his own trees, not for someone managing a whole client list, and nothing says it covers the eco-scheme records that actually get paid.

I'd open it on my phone out of curiosity, but it's built for one grower with their own groves, not for me keeping diaries for 150 clients. I'm not retyping every spraying and fertilising job for each of them by hand when my current spreadsheets and ΚΥΔ software already do the ΟΣΔΕ part.
